title: Dead Dry Grass
description: Gives dry grass a dead variant in snowy biomes.
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d332cdab77737cd016fd7c1ae13efef260cbc7_0.webp)

**Dead Dry Grass** adds an orange, dead grass variant that appears in snowy biomes. 

Due to a bug with snowy grass, the snow texture has been applied to the top of it.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/032b3169badbdce870ae6ae179be88f8150e0e9a_0.webp)

Continuity and Polytone
